title: Eight Winters and One Short Label
subtitle: 科学研究 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学研究（人与社会·科学与技术）
meta: 主题语境：科学研究（人与社会·科学与技术）　|　核心词汇：equipment　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 equipment 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 my father ① set up equipment that no student in the lab would have used, and he said the setting up was the whole of the winter. The ② equipment, meaning the tools themselves and not the room, ran eight winters and stayed unused in the book; equipment, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unused.

Every ③ piece of equipment in that lab had the same short label beside it, and the ④ equipment at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the night and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Equipment, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to use; my father said the using is the part that fills eight winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the equipment was the whole of the experiment, meaning the system and not the tools. The ⑥ equipment, meaning the system and not any of that, is the only thing in an experiment that everybody waits for and nobody uses; equipment, he said, is either something you set up or the only word that means both tools and a system. He said the system is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ equipment had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short label. The ⑧ equipment of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one lab and eight winters of using; equipment, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to use. He said the using was never mentioned.

The ⑨ equipment I remember is the one used in the list, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ piece of equipment, my mother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being used; every equipment, she said, is a system that has agreed to look like a set of tools. She said the system was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 设备；器材（指实验室里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 设备（指那些工具本身，与房间相对）
C. 固定搭配：set up equipment 安装／配备设备
D. n. 设备（指留给夜班使用的那一套）
E. n. 设备（抽象总称，指一项实验的装备之事）
F. n. 设备（指清单上写到、被登记的那一套）
G. n. 装备；成套系统（指实验里人人都等却无人使用的那样东西）
H. n. 系统（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人使用的那种装置）

items.q: set up equipment that no student in the lab would have used
The equipment, meaning the tools themselves and not the room
Every piece of equipment in that lab
the equipment at the far side
the equipment was the whole of the experiment
the equipment had become a line in a list
The equipment of the whole thing

answers.why: set up equipment 意为“安装／配备设备”，1969 年父亲安装了一套实验室里没有一位学生肯使用的设备。
equipment 意为“设备”，指那些工具本身而不是房间，它经过了八个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
equipment 意为“设备”，指实验室里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一张短短的标签。
equipment 意为“设备”，指留给夜班使用的那一套，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
equipment 意为“装备、成套系统”，指实验里人人都等却无人使用的那样东西，叔叔说这套装备就是那项实验的全部。
equipment 意为“系统”，指人人都等却无人使用的那种装置而不是那些工具，是实验里人人都等、却无人使用的东西。
equipment 意为“设备”，指清单上写到、被登记的那一套，到 1975 年这一套成了清单里的一行。
equipment 意为“设备”，父亲一月写道，整件事的装备之事是一间实验室和八个冬天的使用。
equipment 意为“设备”，我记得的是清单上登记的那一套，1978 年结束了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一套。
equipment 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，一件设备是唯一会因为被好好使用而变得更好的东西。
